register_processor: register a new multimodal processor class under a name in the PROCESSORS registry
build_HFProcessor_get_input: build a processor to tokenize multimodal messages with images for Qwen2-VL or mllama models
build_CogVLM2Processor_get_input: build a processor to prepare conversation input IDs and padded tensors for CogVLM2 models
build_LlavaProcessor_get_input: build a processor to preprocess multimodal text and image inputs for LLaVA model calibration
build_LongCatNextProcessor_get_input: build a processor to handle text image and audio inputs for LongCat-Next multimodal models
